name: Claude Monet
bio: French painter and founder of Impressionist painting who is seen as a key precursor to modernism, especially in his attempt to paint nature as he perceived it.
bioPl: Francuski malarz, główny przedstawiciel i twórca impresjonizmu. Słynny z uchwycenia światła i pór dnia w seriach obrazów takich как Giverny i Nimfy.
